release_notes:
• [SUBSCRIPTIONS & TIERS] 4 plan tiers (1 Month @ ₹299, 3 Months @ ₹1,058, 6 Months @ ₹2,012, 12 Months @ ₹3,823) with auto-validity extension (+30, +90, +180, +365 days)
• [RAZORPAY CHECKOUT] Instant online licensing checkout via Razorpay with real-time status verification
• [DUPLICATE GUARD] Active tier shows 'Already Done • Subscribed' to prevent accidental double-billing, with automatic renewal re-enabling upon expiry
• [GST TAX INVOICES] Itemized 18% GST breakdown (9% CGST + 9% SGST), amount in words, in-app viewer, and vector PDF download
• [RESPONSIVE ADMIN UI] Fluid auto-resizing across Desktop (4-column row), Tablet (2x2 grid), and Mobile (stacked cards)
